ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_LP11_IDLE
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: All Lanes driving LP-11 Stop state; host has bus possession; no pending transaction.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_HS_ENTRY
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host issues D-PHY HS Request sequence (LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync 8'b00011101).

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_TX_PACKET_STREAM
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host streams one or more Short/Long Packets back-to-back on HS payload (DI → WC → ECC → payload → Checksum for Long).

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_TX_EOTP
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: If EoTp enabled, host appends Short Packet DI=0x08 (VC=0, DT=0x08), Data=0x0F0F, ECC=0x01 immediately before HS-Trail.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_BTA_REQUEST
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: After a transmission expecting a peripheral response, host asserts TurnRequest to its PHY; PHY drives BTA escape sequence on Data Lane 0.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_LP_RX_WAIT
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host has handed bus to peripheral; LP-RX timer LRX-H_TO running; waiting for peripheral response packets or LP-11 from peripheral.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_LP_RX_DECODE
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host receives Acknowledge / Acknowledge and Error Report / Read Response / TE trigger message in LP mode on Data Lane 0.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_BTA_RETURN
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Peripheral has finished and issued its own BTA; host re-acquires bus and returns to HOST_LP11_IDLE.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_INIT_DRIVE_LP11
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Power-on: host drives sustained LP-11 TX-Stop for T_INIT_MASTER ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY of the peripheral.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_CONTENTION_RECOVERY
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host detected LP Contention (LP-High Fault or LP-Low Fault); LP TX → STOP (drive LP-11); ErrContention flagged; wait Host-Processor-Wait Timeout; optionally issue Reset Entry command.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RX_STOP
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral in LP-RX, all Lanes idle LP-11; waiting for D-PHY SoT.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RX_HS_PAYLOAD
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral receiving HS payload after SoT; parsing DI + WC + ECC; reading WC payload bytes and 2-byte Checksum for Long Packets.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RX_EOTP_DETECT
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral detects EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload=0x0F0F) regardless of transmission mode (HS or LP); decouples end-of-HS from PHY EoT.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_ERROR_ACCUMULATE
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral updates its internal 16-bit Error Register (SoT/SoT Sync/EoT Sync/Escape Entry/LP TX Sync/HS RX Timeout/False Control/ECC Single/ECC Multi/Checksum/DSI DT Not Recognized/DSI VC ID Invalid/Invalid TX Length/DSI Protocol Violation) without clearing it.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_BTA_ACQUIRED
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: BTA received from host (LP Escape sequence on Data Lane 0); peripheral now has bus possession; LTX-P_TO timer running.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_LP_TX_RESPONSE
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral transmits in LP mode: Acknowledge Trigger Message (0x21) if no errors and no Read Request, or Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet (DT=0x02) with Error Register contents, or DCS/Generic Short/Long Read Response packet.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_BTA_RETURN
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral hands bus back to host via its own TurnRequest → BTA sequence; transitions back to PERIPH_RX_STOP.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_TE_TX
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Command Mode peripheral, having been given bus possession via BTA without command, sends LP Escape trigger byte 0x5D (LSB-first 10111010) for Tearing Effect, then returns bus to host.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_INIT_RX_STOP
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral powers up in RX-Stop and ignores all Link states for at least T_INIT_SLAVE.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_HS_RX_TIMEOUT
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: HRX_TO expired during HS RX; peripheral transitions to LP-RX, sets HS RX Timeout bit (bit 5), reports at next BTA.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RESET_RECEIVED
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral received Reset Entry command via LP Escape Mode (per contention recovery); executes reset sequence; PR_TO timer runs while reset completes.

fsm_hints.trigger: HS Entry begins when host drives LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS payload. BTA begins when host asserts TurnRequest at the end of the last packet of a transmission. TE begins when host gives bus possession to peripheral without an accompanying DSI command.
fsm_hints.rule: Packet boundaries are determined by header DT + WC fields. EoTp (when enabled) provides a robust packet-stream terminator independent of D-PHY EoT. BTA uses LP Escape Mode only and is restricted to Data Lane 0.
fsm_hints.abort: Multi-bit ECC errors lose packet boundary for the rest of the transmission (per §8.9.5 / §9.5). HS RX Timeout expiry forces peripheral back to LP-RX. LP Contention triggers Annex A recovery flows (Cases 1/2/3).

anti_deadlock_rule: Required timers HRX_TO (HS RX Timeout, peripheral), HTX_TO (HS TX Timeout, host), LTX-P_TO (LP TX Peripheral Timeout), LRX-H_TO (LP RX Host Timeout) ensure the bus returns to LP-11 Stop state within bounded time after any transient fault. LRX-H_TO MUST be longer than LTX-P_TO so the peripheral has returned to LP-RX before host timer expires. Optional TA_TO (Turnaround Acknowledge Timeout) and PR_TO (Peripheral Reset Timeout) provide additional safety nets.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: Power-up sequence per §5.7: host's T_INIT_MASTER ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY. Host drives LP-11 on all Lanes throughout T_INIT_MASTER. Peripheral powers up in RX-Stop, ignores all Link states until T_INIT_SLAVE elapses (R-C timer with ±30% accuracy is acceptable), then enters PERIPH_RX_STOP. Default Maximum Return Packet Size = 1 at this point.

default_ready_state_recommendation.Clock_Lane_idle: LP-11 (Stop state) between HS bursts when Non-Continuous Clock Mode is selected; HS-0 in Continuous Clock Mode.
default_ready_state_recommendation.Data_Lane_idle: LP-11 (Stop state) when host has bus possession and no traffic; LP-RX when peripheral has bus possession.

lane_states_table_inherited_from_d_phy.meaning: Bridge state before HS / Escape entry; also Escape Mode signaling state
Stop state (idle); both endpoints can hold this

configurations.name: Continuous Clock Mode
configurations.description: Clock Lane stays in HS continuously; Data Lanes alternate HS/LP per burst.

configurations.name: Non-Continuous Clock Mode
configurations.description: Clock Lane returns to LP-11 between HS bursts.

configurations.name: EoTp enabled
configurations.description: EoTp Short Packet appended at end of every HS transmission.

configurations.name: EoTp disabled
configurations.description: Backward-compatible with v1.0 peripherals; relies on D-PHY EoT only.

timing_dependency_rule: Host drives the Clock Lane DDR; peripheral DDR receiver uses both edges to latch one Data-Lane bit each. Sync pattern (8'b00011101 LSB-first on the wire) byte-aligns the receiver. Inter-pair skew across N Data Lanes must remain bounded (per D-PHY) so the de-interleaved byte stream reconstructs correctly.
